$comment: buildCommand is the BUILD step only -- Nixpacks runs the install itself from package-lock.json, in its own phase. Putting 'npm ci' here too fails the build outright: Nixpacks mounts a cache at /app/node_modules/.cache, and npm ci removes node_modules wholesale, so it dies on EBUSY rmdir of the live mount.

Node comes from package.json's engines field (>=22). Nixpacks reads it; without one it picks its own default, which was Node 18 and is older than this codebase's toolchain (workbox-build wants >=20, wrangler >=22).
This file's format is deprecated as of 2026 in favour of .railway/railway.ts, and keeps working until 2026-12-01.
